title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Terms — The Cancellation Charge on a Deposit Pre-Order
content:
**Clause 1. Amount.** The cancellation charge on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order cancelled at will is the reserved unit price times the units times the charge rate. The charge rate is 10 percent.

**Clause 2. Cap, rounding and the refund of the rest.** The charge never exceeds the deposit held on the reservation. It is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The refund of the rest is the deposit held less the charge.

**Clause 3. After a delay notice.** Once any delay notice has been sent for the reservation, no cancellation charge is kept and the whole deposit is refunded.

**Clause 4. Working.** The charge is one product of the reserved unit price, the units and the charge rate, with no intermediate rounding. The cap at the deposit held and the rounding to the cent apply to that product, as the last steps of the calculation.

**Inputs**

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Reserved unit price and units | The reservation record |
| Deposit held | The reservation's history: deposit charged, less anything already refunded, kept or applied |
| Any delay notice | The reservation's history |

**Worked examples (hypothetical Deposit Pre-Orders, no delay notice)**

| Reserved unit price | Units | Deposit held | Price times units times 10 percent | Charge kept | Refund of the rest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $250.00 | 2 | $100.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 |
| $129.95 | 1 | $25.99 | $12.995 | $13.00 | $12.99 |
| $640.00 | 1 | $128.00 | $64.00 | $64.00 | $64.00 |

**With a delay notice.** Take the first example again with one delay notice on the history. The charge kept is $0.00, and the whole $100.00 deposit is refunded.
